hooks.command: E=""; for D in "$METODOLOJI_HOME" "$OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR/.metodoloji/plugin" "$HOME/.openhands/plugins/installed/metodoloji"; do if [ -n "$D" ] && [ -f "$D/hooks/scripts/bootstrap.sh" ]; then E="$D"; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$E" ]; then exec sh "$E/hooks/scripts/bootstrap.sh"; fi; exit 0

E=""; for D in "$METODOLOJI_HOME" "$OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR/.metodoloji/plugin" "$HOME/.openhands/plugins/installed/metodoloji"; do if [ -n "$D" ] && [ -f "$D/hooks/scripts/hook-entry.sh" ]; then E="$D"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$E" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"deny","reason":"Metodoloji plugin bulunamadı — guard fail-closed."; }'; exit 2; fi; exec sh "$E/hooks/scripts/hook-entry.sh" guard

E=""; for D in "$METODOLOJI_HOME" "$OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR/.metodoloji/plugin" "$HOME/.openhands/plugins/installed/metodoloji"; do if [ -n "$D" ] && [ -f "$D/hooks/scripts/hook-entry.sh" ]; then E="$D"; break; fi; done; [ -z "$E" ] && exit 0; exec sh "$E/hooks/scripts/hook-entry.sh" quality

E=""; for D in "$METODOLOJI_HOME" "$OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR/.metodoloji/plugin" "$HOME/.openhands/plugins/installed/metodoloji"; do if [ -n "$D" ] && [ -f "$D/hooks/scripts/hook-entry.sh" ]; then E="$D"; break; fi; done; [ -z "$E" ] && exit 0; exec sh "$E/hooks/scripts/hook-entry.sh" deploy

E=""; for D in "$METODOLOJI_HOME" "$OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR/.metodoloji/plugin" "$HOME/.openhands/plugins/installed/metodoloji"; do if [ -n "$D" ] && [ -f "$D/hooks/scripts/hook-entry.sh" ]; then E="$D"; break; fi; done; [ -z "$E" ] && exit 0; exec sh "$E/hooks/scripts/hook-entry.sh" audit

E=""; for D in "$METODOLOJI_HOME" "$OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR/.metodoloji/plugin" "$HOME/.openhands/plugins/installed/metodoloji"; do if [ -n "$D" ] && [ -f "$D/hooks/scripts/hook-entry.sh" ]; then E="$D"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$E" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"deny","reason":"Metodoloji plugin bulunamadı — stop fail-closed."}' ; exit 2; fi; exec sh "$E/hooks/scripts/hook-entry.sh" stop
